environment: Docker on Mac server, PostgreSQL 16, isolated tmpfs test database
tests: scrypt hashes are salted and verify without storing plaintext
password length policy and tokens
roles fail closed
student input rejects missing/invalid data and normalizes identifiers
migration 007 is additive and repeatable
stored passwords and session tokens are hashes; cookie is HttpOnly/SameSite
unknown, wrong password and disabled accounts receive generic errors
unauthenticated requests and spoofed demo headers cannot read school data
session restore and role/identity are server-derived
teachers only see their own courses and enrolled students
students cannot access another student, courses, enrollments or unpublished grades
mutations require matching origin and CSRF; login rejects cross-origin
teacher writes use actual assignments; out-of-scope and student writes are denied
student grades require publication flags and never leak another student's rows
academic roster is assignment-scoped and rejects students and other teachers
attendance is visible only to its student; stale, future and atomic out-of-scope writes fail
evaluation creation validates weights and serializes concurrent totals
grades validate scale and enrollment, remain draft and publish explicitly
grade corrections require reason, version and audit; student cannot write
positive/negative annotations honor private and student visibility and owner-only void
academic records and visibility survive API restart
create student persists with actor/date and rejects incomplete or duplicate input
student updates are audited, validated and reject stale writes
enrollment validates period, course, student status and concurrent duplicates
closing enrollment retains immutable history and removes active teacher scope
capacity and inactive courses reject enrollments; re-enrollment creates a new historical record
real API process restart preserves students, enrollments, audit and sessions
sessions rotate at login and revoke on logout and logout-all
absolute expiry and inactivity timeout reject persisted sessions
password change verifies old password, hashes new password and revokes all sessions
login rate limiting is stored in PostgreSQL and survives restart
removed roles are denied even with an existing session
student status, invalid identifiers and unknown course IDs are rejected
production requires HTTPS origin and sets Secure __Host cookies
